description: Cross-language conformance for a pure-I/O data SOURCE consumed by the owning model's OWN equations (esm-spec §8.5; CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md §5.11). From 1.0.0 a data source is a registry entry rather than a component, so each former loader variable is a PARAMETER of the owning model carrying an `update` that names the source and binds a file variable. The flattener must lower each such parameter to a const-array-backed input `<owner>.<var>`, and simulate must bind its value so BOTH a bare-scalar reference (`k`) AND a gather (`index(wind, 2)`) resolve. The forcing is CONST, so the golden trajectory is analytic and exact. Complements `tests/valid/advection_reaction_loaded_ic_bc.esm` and `pkg/earthsci-ast-py/tests/fixtures/loader_injection/loader_consumer.esm`, which cover source-backed parameters consumed via a gather but NOT direct bare-scalar consumption.
